standard.summary: 启用缓存会复用 GPU 权重副本；仅观察只生成候选报告。
standard.effect: 只改变权重驻留和搬运，不改变训练目标或导出格式。
standard.whenToUse: 要减少搬运请选择启用缓存；要查看候选而不占缓存显存请选择仅观察。
standard.avoidWhen: 全 GPU 驻留时没有重复权重搬运可节约。

optionDescriptions.observe: 仅观察，不建立手动缓存。
optionDescriptions.cache_v0: 启用预算内的冻结权重缓存。

standard_en.summary: Cache mode reuses GPU weight copies; observe mode only reports candidates.
standard_en.effect: Changes residency and transfers, without changing the training objective or export format.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose cache mode to reduce copies, or observe to inspect candidates without allocating a manual cache.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Fully resident weights have no repeated offload transfers to avoid.

optionDescriptions.observe: Observe only; allocate no manual cache.

advanced.principle: MOSS、Krea2 等分块卸载复用同一控制器；Krea2 支持逐层缓存，传统 swap 支持冻结 Linear/Conv2d。新接线仅选择普通 FP16/BF16/FP32 冻结参数；特殊量化格式继续原卸载。Anima、Newbie 和 Native SDXL 保留已有缓存路径。
advanced.tradeoffs: 当前按显式预算静态选择，不是动态 I/O 预测。运行报告包含实际缓存量、选中层和命中次数。

advanced_en.principle: Shared block offload, Krea2 layer offload and traditional Linear/Conv2d swap use the same planner. New adapters select plain frozen FP16/BF16/FP32 parameters; specialized quantized formats keep their existing path. Anima, Newbie and native SDXL retain their existing caches.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Selection is static within the explicit budget, not dynamic I/O prediction. Runtime reports include actual bytes, selected layers and hits.
